name: Stormplains
description: Plains of Tarkir where the dragonstorms warp the land and from which Narset and Elspeth enter the storm.

description_citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, desperate to regain his draconic form, hunts a young dragon for its heart under Taigam's direction.
timeline.quote: This is how you fly with a dragon's wings once more,

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan spears the dragon and Taigam binds it with blue fire to pin it down.
timeline.quote: The blade sank through the dragon's cheek and then deeper

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan cuts out the dragon's heart, chants with Taigam, senses the spell's corruption, and bites into the heart.
timeline.quote: he bit down into the organ.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani prepares to lead Abzan riders in a gazelle hunt, unsettled by the herd and Nur's words.
timeline.quote: Much to his chagrin, Nur had gotten into his head with that last conversation.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: A wave of magic panics the herd and the Abzan dragons throw their riders as a huge red dragon rises with a flight of smaller ones.
timeline.quote: a dragon of improbable size: red-scaled, triumphant, roaring as dozens of its smaller brethren rose to join it.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani recognizes the giant dragon as Sarkhan in his transformed dragon form.
timeline.quote: It was Sarkhan in his dragon form.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset and Elspeth step into the dragonstorm, shielded by blue light, and walk toward a bright light amid forming dragons.
timeline.quote: Narset stepped into the storm and Elspeth followed.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.
